audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Chronicles / Divrei Hayamim Aleph temple donations, David's prayer, Solomon's anointing, sacrifices, succession, and David's death, first-pass restored draft; later witness audit required
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for Solomon's youth, royal and public giving, voluntary-offering pressure, source of wealth, hyperbolic totals, stewardship prayer, sojourner identity, integrity, animal sacrifice, bowing to king, throne-of-YHWH language, idealized submission, Davidic absolution, and lost archives.

verses.restored: King David said to all assembly, Solomon my son, whom alone Divine has chosen, is young and inexperienced, and work is great, for palace is not for human but for YHWH Divine.

familiar.text: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.

modern.text: Then King David said to the whole assembly, “My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great because this palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְכָל הַקָּהָ֔ל שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה בְנִ֥י אֶחָ֛ד בָּֽחַר בּ֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים נַ֣עַר וָרָ֑ךְ וְהַמְּלָאכָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א לְאָדָם֙ הַבִּירָ֔ה כִּ֖י לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: With all strength I prepared for house of Divine: gold for gold work, silver for silver, bronze for bronze, iron for iron, wood for wood, onyx and setting stones, stones of antimony and colors, every precious stone, and marble in abundance.

familiar.text: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

modern.text: Now with all my ability I have made provision for the house of my God—gold for the gold articles, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron, and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and slabs of marble—all in abundance.

original.text: וּֽכְכָל כֹּחִ֞י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְבֵית אֱלֹהַ֗י הַזָּהָ֣ב לַ֠זָּהָב וְהַכֶּ֨סֶף לַכֶּ֜סֶף וְהַנְּחֹ֣שֶׁת לַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת הַבַּרְזֶל֙ לַבַּרְזֶ֔ל וְהָעֵצִ֖ים לָעֵצִ֑ים אַבְנֵי שֹׁ֨הַם וּמִלּוּאִ֜ים אַבְנֵי פ֣וּךְ וְרִקְמָ֗ה וְכֹ֨ל אֶ֧בֶן יְקָרָ֛ה וְאַבְנֵי שַׁ֖יִשׁ לָרֹֽב

verses.restored: Moreover, because I delight in house of my Divine, I give my personal treasure of gold and silver to house of Divine beyond all prepared for holy house:

familiar.text: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

modern.text: Moreover, because of my delight in the house of my God, I now give for it my personal treasures of gold and silver, over and above all that I have provided for this holy temple:

original.text: וְע֗וֹד בִּרְצוֹתִי֙ בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֔י יֶשׁ לִ֥י סְגֻלָּ֖ה זָהָ֣ב וָכָ֑סֶף נָתַ֤תִּי לְבֵית אֱלֹהַי֙ לְמַ֔עְלָה מִכָּל הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לְבֵ֥ית הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: three thousand talents of gold, gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver to overlay walls of houses,

familiar.text: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:

modern.text: three thousand talents of gold (the gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the buildings,

original.text: שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים כִּכְּרֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מִזְּהַ֣ב אוֹפִ֑יר וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת אֲלָפִ֤ים כִּכַּר כֶּ֨סֶף֙ מְזֻקָּ֔ק לָט֖וּחַ קִיר֥וֹת הַבָּתִּֽים

verses.restored: gold for gold work, silver for silver work, and for all work by hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to fill hand today for YHWH?

familiar.text: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD?

modern.text: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now who will volunteer to consecrate himself to the LORD today?”

original.text: לַזָּהָ֤ב לַזָּהָב֙ וְלַכֶּ֣סֶף לַכֶּ֔סֶף וּלְכָל מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּיַ֣ד חָרָשִׁ֑ים וּמִ֣י מִתְנַדֵּ֔ב לְמַלֹּ֥אות יָד֛וֹ הַיּ֖וֹם לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Then leaders of ancestral houses, tribal leaders, commanders of thousands and hundreds, and officials over king's work offered willingly.

familiar.text: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king’s work, offered willingly,

modern.text: Then the leaders of the households, the officers of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king’s work gave willingly.

original.text: וַיִּֽתְנַדְּבוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הָאָב֜וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְשָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וְהַמֵּא֔וֹת וּלְשָׂרֵ֖י מְלֶ֥אכֶת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: They gave for service of house of Divine five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

familiar.text: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

modern.text: Toward the service of God’s house they gave 5,000 talents and 10,000 darics of gold, 10,000 talents of silver, 18,000 talents of bronze, and 100,000 talents of iron.

original.text: וַֽיִּתְּנ֞וּ לַעֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֣ים חֲמֵֽשֶׁת אֲלָפִים֮ וַאֲדַרְכֹנִ֣ים רִבּוֹ֒ וְכֶ֗סֶף כִּכָּרִים֙ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּנְחֹ֕שֶׁת רִבּ֛וֹ וּשְׁמוֹנַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים כִּכָּרִ֑ים וּבַרְזֶ֖ל מֵֽאָה אֶ֥לֶף כִּכָּרִֽים

verses.restored: Whoever had precious stones gave them to treasury of house of YHWH under hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

familiar.text: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the LORD, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

modern.text: Whoever had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the LORD, under the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.

original.text: וְהַנִּמְצָ֤א אִתּוֹ֙ אֲבָנִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ לְאוֹצַ֣ר בֵּית יְהוָ֑ה עַ֥ל יַד יְחִיאֵ֖ל הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי

verses.restored: People rejoiced because they offered willingly, for with whole heart they offered to YHWH; David the king also rejoiced greatly.

familiar.text: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

modern.text: And the people rejoiced at the willing response of their leaders, for they had given to the LORD freely and wholeheartedly. And King David also rejoiced greatly. David’s Prayer of Blessing

original.text: וַיִּשְׂמְח֤וּ הָעָם֙ עַל הִֽתְנַדְּבָ֔ם כִּ֚י בְּלֵ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם הִֽתְנַדְּב֖וּ לַיהוָ֑ה וְגַם֙ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׂמַ֖ח שִׂמְחָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה

verses.restored: David blessed YHWH before all assembly, saying, Blessed are you, YHWH Divine of Israel our ancestor, from age to age.

familiar.text: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

modern.text: Then David blessed the LORD in the sight of all the assembly and said: “May You be blessed, O LORD, God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.

original.text: וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד בָּר֨וּךְ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֔ינוּ מֵעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: Yours, YHWH, are greatness, power, glory, victory, and majesty, for all in heavens and earth is yours. Yours is kingdom, YHWH, and you are lifted as head above all.

familiar.text: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.

modern.text: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.

original.text: לְךָ֣ יְ֠הוָה הַגְּדֻלָּ֨ה וְהַגְּבוּרָ֤ה וְהַתִּפְאֶ֨רֶת֙ וְהַנֵּ֣צַח וְהַה֔וֹד כִּי כֹ֖ל בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ לְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ הַמַּמְלָכָ֔ה וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂ֖א לְכֹ֥ל לְרֹֽאשׁ

verses.restored: Riches and honor come from before you, and you rule over all; in your hand are power and might, and in your hand to make great and strengthen all.

familiar.text: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

modern.text: Both riches and honor come from You, and You are the ruler over all. In Your hands are power and might to exalt and give strength to all.

original.text: וְהָעֹ֤שֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד֙ מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַתָּה֙ מוֹשֵׁ֣ל בַּכֹּ֔ל וּבְיָדְךָ֖ כֹּ֣חַ וּגְבוּרָ֑ה וּבְיָ֣דְךָ֔ לְגַדֵּ֥ל וּלְחַזֵּ֖ק לַכֹּֽל

verses.restored: Now, our Divine, we thank you and praise your glorious name.

familiar.text: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

modern.text: Now therefore, our God, we give You thanks, and we praise Your glorious name.

original.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ מוֹדִ֥ים אֲנַ֖חְנוּ לָ֑ךְ וּֽמְהַֽלְלִ֖ים לְשֵׁ֥ם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: Who am I and who are my people that we should have strength to offer willingly like this? For all is from you, and from your hand we have given to you.

familiar.text: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.

modern.text: But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? For everything comes from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You.

original.text: וְכִ֨י מִ֤י אֲנִי֙ וּמִ֣י עַמִּ֔י כִּֽי נַעְצֹ֣ר כֹּ֔חַ לְהִתְנַדֵּ֖ב כָּזֹ֑את כִּֽי מִמְּךָ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל וּמִיָּדְךָ֖ נָתַ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ

verses.restored: For we are sojourners before you and temporary residents, as all ancestors; our days on earth are like shadow, and there is no lasting hope in possession.

familiar.text: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.

modern.text: For we are foreigners and strangers in Your presence, as were all our forefathers. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.

original.text: כִּֽי גֵרִ֨ים אֲנַ֧חְנוּ לְפָנֶ֛יךָ וְתוֹשָׁבִ֖ים כְּכָל אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ כַּצֵּ֧ל יָמֵ֛ינוּ עַל הָאָ֖רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין מִקְוֶֽה

verses.restored: YHWH our Divine, all this abundance prepared to build house for holy name is from your hand, and all is yours.

familiar.text: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.

modern.text: O LORD our God, from Your hand comes all this abundance that we have provided to build You a house for Your holy Name, and all of it belongs to You.

original.text: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ כֹ֣ל הֶהָמ֤וֹן הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲכִינֹ֔נוּ לִבְנֽוֹת לְךָ֥ בַ֖יִת לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ מִיָּדְךָ֥ היא וּלְךָ֥ הַכֹּֽל

verses.restored: I know, my Divine, you test heart and delight in uprightness. In uprightness of heart I willingly offered all these, and now I have seen your people present offering willingly with joy.

familiar.text: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.

modern.text: I know, my God, that You test the heart and delight in uprightness. All these things I have given willingly and with an upright heart, and now I have seen Your people who are present here giving joyfully and willingly to You.

original.text: וְיָדַ֣עְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן לֵבָ֔ב וּמֵישָׁרִ֖ים תִּרְצֶ֑ה אֲנִ֗י בְּיֹ֤שֶׁר לְבָבִי֙ הִתְנַדַּ֣בְתִּי כָל אֵ֔לֶּה וְעַתָּ֗ה עַמְּךָ֙ הַנִּמְצְאוּ פֹ֔ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה לְהִֽתְנַדֶּב לָֽךְ

verses.restored: YHWH Divine of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel our ancestors, keep this forever as formation of thoughts of heart of your people, and establish their heart toward you.

familiar.text: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:

modern.text: O LORD, God of our fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, keep this desire forever in the intentions of the hearts of Your people, and direct their hearts toward You.

original.text: יְהוָ֗ה אֱ֠לֹהֵי אַבְרָהָ֞ם יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ שֳׁמְרָה זֹּ֣את לְעוֹלָ֔ם לְיֵ֥צֶר מַחְשְׁב֖וֹת לְבַ֣ב עַמֶּ֑ךָ וְהָכֵ֥ן לְבָבָ֖ם אֵלֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Give Solomon my son a whole heart to guard commandments, testimonies, and statutes, to do all and build palace for which I prepared.

familiar.text: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.

modern.text: And give my son Solomon a whole heart to keep and carry out all Your commandments, decrees, and statutes, and to build Your palace for which I have made provision.”

original.text: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֗י תֵּ֚ן לֵבָ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם לִשְׁמוֹר֙ מִצְוֺתֶ֔יךָ עֵדְוֺתֶ֖יךָ וְחֻקֶּ֑יךָ וְלַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַכֹּ֔ל וְלִבְנ֖וֹת הַבִּירָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר הֲכִינֽוֹתִי

verses.restored: David said to all assembly, Bless YHWH your Divine. All assembly blessed YHWH Divine of ancestors and bowed, paying homage to YHWH and king.

familiar.text: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD, and the king.

modern.text: Then David said to the whole assembly, “Blessed be the LORD your God.” So the whole assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers. They bowed down and paid homage to the LORD and to the king. Solomon Anointed King (1 Kings 1:32–40)

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִיד֙ לְכָל הַקָּהָ֔ל בָּֽרְכוּ נָ֖א אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וַיְבָרֲכ֣וּ כָֽל הַקָּהָ֗ל לַיהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹֽתֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּקְּד֧וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ לַיהוָ֖ה וְלַמֶּֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: They brought sacrifices to YHWH and offered burnt offerings next day: one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, one thousand lambs, with drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

familiar.text: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

modern.text: The next day they offered sacrifices and presented burnt offerings to the LORD: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, along with their drink offerings, and other sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

original.text: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה זְ֠בָחִים וַיַּעֲל֨וּ עֹל֜וֹת לַיהוָ֗ה לְֽמָחֳרַת֮ הַיּ֣וֹם הַהוּא֒ פָּרִ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף אֵילִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף כְּבָשִׂ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֑ם וּזְבָחִ֥ים לָרֹ֖ב לְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: They ate and drank before YHWH that day with great joy. They made Solomon son of David king a second time and anointed him to YHWH as ruler, and Zadok as priest.

familiar.text: And did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the LORD to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.

modern.text: That day they ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the LORD. Then, for a second time, they designated David’s son Solomon as king, anointing him before the LORD as ruler, and Zadok as the priest.

translation_notes: Solomon is again called young and inexperienced before an enormous public project and succession ceremony; public acclaim does not prove uncoerced consent.
David's personal and royal wealth came through taxation, tribute, plunder, land, labor, and administration. Donation does not erase how wealth was accumulated.
The invitation to offer 'willingly' occurs in a royal public assembly after the king gives extravagantly; social and political pressure must be acknowledged.
The immense totals may be rhetorical or textually unstable and must not justify prosperity preaching or institutional hoarding.
Artisans' hands are named as the destination of materials; workers remain agents entitled to pay, safety, rest, and credit.
David's prayer that all belongs to Divine should support stewardship and humility, not institutional seizure of personal property.
Calling the community sojourners and temporary residents should cultivate hospitality toward migrants and loosen possessive nationalism.
Heart-testing belongs to Divine theology and cannot authorize leaders to police thoughts or demand financial proof of sincerity.
The assembly bows to YHWH and king in one verse; homage to a ruler is not worship and must not become leader cult.
Three thousand animals are killed in the ceremony; their lives and labor around the feast remain visible.
'Throne of YHWH' is royal theology, not a claim that monarchs are Divine or beyond removal.
All David's sons submitting to Solomon idealizes succession and omits Adonijah's conflict from Kings.
David's good death, wealth, and honor do not absolve Bathsheba's abuse, Uriah's murder, Tamar's abandonment, wars, census deaths, or other harms.
The cited prophetic records are not preserved as separate complete books; archival claims require humility.
safety_note: Reject coerced giving, prosperity fundraising, wealth laundering, leader worship, divine monarchy, thought policing, animal invisibility, and the absolution of David by a good ending. Center voluntary consent, migrants, artisans, financial transparency, Solomon's youth, and the survivors omitted from the closing celebration.
